reauth_confirm.title: Renew DESLOC session
reauth_confirm.description: Capture a new session for the same lock and enter it below.

session.title: DESLOC app session
session.description: Enter the session from the local capture to control C100 Plus and read battery and Wi-Fi signal. A new capture is required if this session expires.

menu_options.account: Sign in with email and password

account.title: DESLOC account
account.description: Sign in with your existing DESLOC account. Home Assistant keeps a password-equivalent digest for session renewal. DESLOC may email a verification code for this installation.

verification.title: Verify this installation
verification.description: Enter the code DESLOC sent to your account email. The code is used once and is not saved.

error.invalid_auth: DESLOC rejected these credentials. Check the account or capture a new session.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the DESLOC device list.
error.no_devices: No C100 Plus was found in the returned device list.
error.device_mismatch: This session does not contain the configured lock.
error.invalid_account: Enter your DESLOC email and password.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid or expired.
error.cannot_send_code: DESLOC could not send a code. Wait before starting setup again.
error.captcha_required: Complete the security challenge in the DESLOC app, then try again. Captured-session setup is also available.
error.clock_error: Synchronize the Home Assistant host clock and try again.

abort.device_mismatch: This account does not contain the configured lock.
abort.no_devices: No C100 Plus was returned for this account.
